name: arm-cortex-m
comment: The ARM Cortex-M architectures a bare-metal Rho project targets. A chip names this as its arch and inherits the toolchain and the flags below.

debug.comment: the probe decides the interface and the board decides the target config, so a chip names both and this names only what every Cortex-M shares; a chip with no probe of its own inherits this and a board with a probe of its own declares a whole block rather than editing these
